# v1.3.1 - recordings no longer lose their first half second
A fix for the most annoying thing about recording in DubStage: the start of a line went missing, and the sound cut in late.

### Fixed

- **The first half second of a recording was missing.** Three delays added up:
  - recording started 300 ms *after* "Go!" appeared — whoever started speaking
    on the signal lost exactly that part;
  - the microphone was only opened at that moment, and many devices — USB and
    especially Bluetooth headsets — deliver silence for a few hundred
    milliseconds after opening; Bluetooth also switches profiles then, which
    briefly cuts the sound;
  - the driver's input latency was not accounted for, so the take sat slightly
    late against the picture.

  DubStage now opens the microphone as soon as the countdown starts, so the
  device is ready by the time it matters, starts recording and video exactly
  on "Go!", and skips what the driver still had buffered, so your take lines
  up with the video.

### Updating

Use the update banner in the app, or install `DubStage-Setup-1.3.1.exe` below
over your existing installation — packs, recordings and settings stay.

Full history in [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md).
